name: Birla Carbon (Thailand) Public Company Limited
summary: Birla Carbon (Thailand) Public Company Limited manufactures and sells carbon black under the Birla Carbon, Raven, and Conductex brands in Thailand, Japan, Indonesia, Vietnam, Malaysia, the Philippines, China, Korea, Taiwan, Australia, and internationally. The company was formerly known as Thai Carbon Black Public Company Limited and changed its name to Birla Carbon (Thailand) Public Company Limited in July 2018. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
